item.title: Avolon: $420 Million Samurai Loan Facility Raised By Aviation Finance Company
item.description: Avolon announced it has raised $420 million through its inaugural Samurai loan facility, marking the largest debut Samurai issuance by a European company and the firm’s first borrowing that is not denominated in U.S. dollars. item.title: Avantus: $300 Million Construction Financing Secured For Arizona Solar And Energy Storage Project
